title: Pre-trade checklist
dek: Inner reasoning wing: the five-field pre-trade checklist (thesis, confirmation gauge, invalidation, scenario worst case, size derivation) with a worked example from the live Block Board record.

claims.text: Worked example FR-20261022-B-202703-P: probation budget 0.250R ($62,500) over a scenario loss of $669.57 per lot sized 93 lots of PUT VERTICAL ENVELOPE +P80; -P65; scenario worst case $62,270, structural bound the full $161,820 debit.
